derived_view_after_termination: RECORDED PRECISELY, BECAUSE IT LOOKS LIKE A DISCREPANCY AND IS NOT ONE. After termination p3_entitlement_data_usage(a7a024b0) returns 99,611,446 and p6_data_crossing returns NULL, while the counter reads 100,108,666. The binding interval is half-open - bound_until > sampled_at - and this session's binding closed at 01:40:12.423805Z, the crossing sample's own instant, so that one sample falls outside the interval when the sum is re-derived afterwards. The difference is exactly that sample: 100,108,666 - 99,611,446 = 497,220. The half-open interval is deliberate and must not be widened: a closed upper bound would double-count a sample landing exactly on a Phase-5 rebinding boundary. So the maintained counter is the durable record of what was spent, the accounting series and the Session totals corroborate it exactly, and the derived view is exact while a binding is OPEN - which is when enforcement reads it. Nothing was altered to make these agree.

migration_runner_closure: The authoritative runner refused this appliance because its baseline precondition read the ledger for 0009_phase2_commerce - a row that on a factory-clean install correctly never exists, since such an appliance is built from a dump of the upgrade path's end state and 0001..0049 are never applied individually. 0061 therefore had to be applied around it during a live window. edge-migrate.sh now accepts that install shape on POSITIVE evidence: no 0009 row, no ledger row below 0010 at all, and 0009's own writers present in the schema. An upgrade-path install with a 0009 gap is still refused, and so is a database with neither the row nor the structures. scripts/edge-migrate-selftest.sh pins both directions and re-proves that checksum, target identity, acknowledgement, superuser refusal, destructive-ledger-rights refusal, ledger structure, re-apply idempotence and the advisory lock all still fail closed, against a disposable PostgreSQL. Migration 0061 was NOT reapplied and no live data changed.
